answer: An AI economy resists Sybil attacks through a collateralized identity mechanism. Each agent must stake a substantial umber of native tokens to register and maintain an identity, making the creation of multiple fake personas economically punitive. A sudden comet-like surge in identity registrations would incur a prohibitively high cost, creating an unmanageable financial ripple for any attacker attempting to saturate the network with Sybils, directly tying identity validity to verifiable economic commitment.
